scope: Temporary representative workloads; no business distribution/SLO supplied. Not a parameter search.
correctness_gate: tests/correctness-v3/result.json passed=true; per-request output token IDs/text must match cold consumer reference.

deployment.precision: original GLM5.3 W8A8C8 with Indexer int8
deployment.data_transport: SDMA only; control/metadata/text token HTTP separate
deployment.backend: MemCache/MemFabric1.2.0 with loader-fix-v3; whole-chunk GLM C8 resume Python patch

warmup: One full concurrency wave before each measured block; second round uses reversed case order.
client: Actual local HTTP streaming front door on node32, server and client in separate threads; all P/D backend work, queuing, handoff and text streaming included. Monotonic client timestamps; no cross-host wall-clock subtraction.
cache_identity: Input IDs fixed per case; unique validated cache_salt per logical request shared by its P and D calls. Changes cache hash namespace, not model input values. Per-request consumer hit/need-load logs audited after timing.
metrics: actual validated output tokens per measured wall-second
timing_constraints: No profiler, weight transfer, payload hash or evidence archive transfer during measured blocks. Tiny request/response control and fixed resource queries are instrument overhead included consistently. No production goodput/SLO or global optimality claim.

mechanism_candidate.hypothesis: Hand off P first token as owned output, append its ID to D prompt and generate only the remainder. For block-aligned original input, D can retain the full prompt from the pool, avoiding conservative last-block recomputation and duplicate generation of the first token.
mechanism_candidate.fixed: Same model, operators, quantization, input IDs, final output IDs, request load, SDMA and deployment.
mechanism_candidate.prediction: D external cached prefix increases by one whole block at aligned input; D output generation decreases by one token; exact final output maintained. TTFT, visible text, first handoff gap and end-to-end changes all measured; no redefined timing origin.
mechanism_candidate.comparison: Naive and append_first via same real HTTP front door; ABBA blocks at 1024/64 C1 and C4. Cache identities always unique; correctness failures invalidate timing.
